business_problem: Yorkshire Ambulance Service handles extensive operational information, reports, and communications. Staff need to identify themes, prepare information for different audiences, and understand patient-pathway data while managing administrative work; the service also aims to reduce avoidable emergency-department conveyance.
solution_summary: Yorkshire Ambulance Service uses Microsoft Copilot to assist managers and digital-information teams with operational reporting and communications; staff retain responsibility for decisions. The source material described includes reports, service and conveyance data, and NHS guidance. Copilot organizes information, summarizes long reports, surfaces themes across data, and helps draft emails, briefings, and practical instructions for different audiences. Managers review outputs using operational expertise, while Robinson and colleagues review and adapt drafts before sharing them with frontline teams, the contact center, forums, or senior NHS leaders. Copilot also helps collate conveyance data to identify opportunities in patient pathways. The article specifies administrative use, not clinical work, and does not name source applications, data stores, APIs, deployment topology, or automated connectors; those implementation layers therefore cannot be detailed.

source_references.title: Before the ambulance arrives: How AI is helping the NHS rethink patient care

evidence_quotes: Microsoft Copilot does not make decisions for him, he says. Instead, it organizes information into a format he can review and interrogate using his operational expertise.
Copilot “gives us that ability to join dots that we wouldn’t see ourselves without a laborious several hours’ worth of trawling through data reports and trying to look at common themes.”
Copilot has helped Yorkshire Ambulance Service to collate the data and understand where opportunities could be, which has supported an improvement from 60% to 56% conveyance today.
The NHS has put clear, strict safeguards around its use of Microsoft Copilot: it is only for administrative tasks, not clinical work.
